module: DEPRECATED UI router service: the main flow now builds NavigationEntries directly with ResolvedRoute.createEntry(). This module remains for possible external callers: it resolves a route name into a resolved table and compares two routes.

resolve.desc: Resolves a route name (possibly relative, resolved with utils.resolveRelativeRoute if a current route is provided) into a resolved route via routeManager.getRoute then ResolvedRoute.createResolved. Returns nil with a warning if the route is not found or creation fails. Deprecated.

isEqualRoutes.desc: Compares two routes: same `name` and same `params` (value-by-value comparison, non-recursive).

returns.desc: true if identical; false if either is nil.
